description: This Java class defines PlayerSetupActivity, an Android activity that manages user interface screens for player setup in a game, including animations, button interactions, and managing different stages of input collection.

classes.name: PlayerSetupActivity
classes.description: An Android activity to allow the user to configure game player details through animated UI transitions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and prepares the UI for user interaction.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Overrides default finish to disable transition animations.

methods.name: setupButton
methods.description: Configures a button with touch animations.

methods.name: buttonClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks to animate selection and transition to next setup stage.

methods.name: selectDifficulty
methods.description: Handler for selecting difficulty level options.

methods.name: setupNumberButton
methods.description: Creates a number button with random background color.

methods.name: popChildrenIn
methods.description: Animates child views to appear with scaling effects sequentially.

methods.name: slideToNext
methods.description: Animates the transition between setup screens with skew and translation.
